question.text: Two beams of red and violet colours are made to pass separately through a prism (angle of the prism is $60^{\circ}$ ). In the position of minimum deviation, the angle of refraction will be

options.text: equal but not $30^{\circ}$ for both the colours

solution.text:
At minimum deviation $\left(\delta=\delta_m\right)$ :
$$
r_1=r_2=\frac{A}{2}=\frac{60^{\circ}}{2}=30^{\circ}
$$
(For both colours)
$\therefore$ correct answer is (a).
